scope: Qualify space_record_oplog.space when listRepoOps joins space_record.
Provide a read-authorized, snapshot-stable full-state getRepo CAR with signed-commit and DRISL roots.
Bound getRepo memory with canonical index and record spools, keyset reads, record CID validation, and disk-backed block deduplication.
Keep the pinned cache and its source archive immutable.
nonGoals: This is a disposable lab overlay, not a replacement upstream pin.
The CAR is unavailable for a never-written repo because no LtHash revision exists to sign.
Blob blocks, auth policy changes, and cross-host notification behavior are outside this overlay.
